audio.title: Audio
cli.help:
piviz [--port NAME] [--soundfont FILE.sf2] [--black | --transparent]

  --port         MIDI port to use (default: the first instrument)
  --soundfont    SoundFont to load
  --black        pure black background, for keying in OBS
  --transparent  transparent background (alpha channel for OBS)
  --bench        diagnostics: simulated playing, no vsync, fps in the console

Shortcuts: F1 or H settings, F11 fullscreen
